evidence.title: fix(core): accept Claude Code tool names in tool hook matchers by qqqys · Pull Request #11826 · QwenLM/qwen-code · GitHub

name: fix(core): accept Claude Code tool names in tool hook matchers
summary: Merged pull request in QwenLM/qwen-code: tool hook matchers now accept Claude Code tool names like Bash, Read and Write.
description: Merged pull request (#11826) in QwenLM/qwen-code: tool hook matchers (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PermissionRequest, PermissionDenied) now accept every tool name a permission rule accepts for the same tool, including Claude Code's Bash, Read and Write, so a matcher copied from a Claude Code config matches unchanged; each accepted name still identifies exactly one tool. One of the Claude Code compatibility fixes tracked by #11610.
